name: Peninsula (San Francisco Peninsula oak woodland, dry summer)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2 for the rough). Stanford Golf Course in the foothills behind the campus, from the developer's photos (release stanford-data): bright, warm irrigated turf; olive rough; bright cream bunker sand; a shaded, olive-brown creek; and outside the course the golden summer grass of the California foothills (L0-L2, the out-of-bounds ground). Woods ground (G0-G2) is the dark olive of oak duff. Trees in assets-src/trees_peninsula.py: live and valley oaks, eucalyptus, redwoods and pines. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
